purpose: Transparent smoke-test scoring for runtime/rescoring validation only. Not a psychometric model and not suitable for public interpretation.

algorithm.scaleNormalization: divide each numeric response by the maximum absolute numeric value defined by its response scale

limitations: Diagnostic, categorical, vignette-choice, paired-choice, and ranking responses are excluded unless they use an eligible numeric scale and signed target relation.
All eligible items receive equal weight.
No item discrimination, thresholds, factor loadings, reliability, population norms, or uncertainty estimates are used.
Importance and moral-relevance scales are normalized only for engineering consistency; the resulting means must not be interpreted as validated latent trait estimates.
Derived constructs are not scored directly.
Categorical, derived and deprecated constructs are not numeric scales. Profile comparisons use exact raw item evidence, never these engineering means.
